recognize_zh: 中倍 cyclin D1 染色，大多數小淋巴樣細胞呈細胞核棕色陽性（強弱不一），左側殘存區域的小淋巴球則為陰性，形成清楚的陽性腫瘤區與陰性背景對比。
features: Majority of small lymphoid cells with nuclear cyclin D1 positivity of variable intensity
Staining is strictly nuclear with occasional strongly positive nuclei
Sharp demarcation from a negative zone of small lymphocytes at left (residual non-neoplastic tissue)
Negative scattered histiocytes and endothelial-lined spaces within the infiltrate
Small, round to irregular nuclei consistent with small-to-medium cell size
describe_en: Cyclin D1 immunostain shows nuclear positivity of variable intensity in the majority of small-to-medium lymphoid cells forming the infiltrate. A zone of negative small lymphocytes at the left edge is sharply demarcated from the positive population, and scattered histiocytes are negative. Nuclear cyclin D1 expression in a small B-cell infiltrate is the key surrogate for t(11;14)(q13;q32). Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is cyclin D1 negative apart from occasional weak staining in proliferation centers.
Myeloma cells are also cyclin D1 positive but have plasmacytoid morphology, express CD138, and lack CD20/CD5.
HCL can show weak cyclin D1 but has abundant cytoplasm (fried-egg), CD5 negativity, and annexin A1/CD25/CD103 positivity.
